With such a demand for this language, there are numerous JavaScript development services offshore to help you build your team. “Hire frontend developer Kyiv” is quite a common request on the web as Ukraine remains an attractive destination for West European countries for offshoring their dedicated development teams.  When partnering with an offshore JavaScript development company, you can tap into the skills of a talented team that includes PHP freelance developer, particularly advantageous when considering Ukraine IT outsourcing for cost-effective and high-quality solutions.

What to Expect in 2023: JavaScript Offshoring Trends

JavaScript is not only mostly used, but also one of the most vastly developing and growing programming languages. If you are interested in your product to align with the latest technologies and tools within JS, take a look at 2020 trends. 

  • React as a leading framework of JavaScript 

According to statistics, the use of React will continue to dominate in 2020 with approximately the same rates as in 2019 – 89% of companies used to React as the major programming framework. Since React is mainly used for building user interfaces, it enables developers to make it interactive and dynamic. 

  • Web components are on the rise

Web components are considerably smaller in size and do not require additional runtime as they are mainly browser-based. Web components operate on most of JS frameworks thus enable developers of different expertise to develop web components. 

  • GraphQL 

Another demanding framework that shows the dramatic interest of IT companies. Designed by Facebook, this framework is aimed at server-side runtime for APIs. The framework identifies the types and fields of client’s interactions and requirements, and then provides particular functions to those. 

  • ES-modules and CDN  

ES-modules are included in the standard of ES6 that describes the work of modules within the browser. This technology, thus, enables developers to add and extract functionality to a particular module which can be further downloaded via CDN. 

Benefits of Hiring JavaScript Developer Offshore

The services of offshore JavaScript development company, agency, firm are becoming more and more interesting for the companies looking for an innovative eye. Let’s see what is so advantageous in having offshore JavaScript developers as a part of your staff.  

  • Large Talent Pool 

Offshoring presupposes you to find professional software developers across the world, whether in Brazil or in the CEE country. Take a look: Kyiv has over 100,000 occupied software specialists, most of which have STEM qualifications. 

  • Solid Technical Expertise

According to Evans Data Survey, approximately 60% of global software developers use JavaScript for web application development. This data proves JS’s demand and solid technical expertise that enables many companies to adapt AJAX, one of the common frameworks of this programming language.

  • New Markets Opportunities

Both large and small companies require business expansion at a certain stage of product development, especially when it comes to promoting a new product. Therefore, hiring JavaScript developers offshore not only entails an innovative eye to the project, but also helps discover new partnerships, enrich customer base, and establish a competitive position on the domestic market. 

  • Save on Labor

Let’s see at the salary rates in the United States: an average US company will spend about $82,000 a year to cover JS developer paycheck, while an offshore JavaScript programmer in Ukraine will cost around $30-40,000. 

  • US vs Ukrainian Tax Regulations

No less important and considerable spending goes to taxes: software engineers are obliged to pay from the lowest 10% to 40% as income taxation; Ukraine has a fixed income tax at the rate of 18% – quite an astonishing difference. 

What Services Can Be Delivered By Offshore JavaScript Programmers?

With an overwhelming demand for JS services, let’s see what services you can have if you hire JavaScript developers offshore.

  • Plug-in Development 

Plug-in is a part of a JS code that is included in a standard JS file. By developing Plug-ins API, companies can post information to URLs, add hyperlinks that will transfer the user to a new URL, get the data from the web using URLs, integrate JS/DOM with the native code. 

  • Mobile and Web Application Development

Since JavaScript is a flexible language that has numerous frameworks, it allows programmers to perform both frontend and backend (using Node.js) for web application development. Moreover, JS allows an offshore JavaScript developer to create Progressive Web Applications (PWAs) that can be installed on mobile devices and accessed via the home screen. 

  • Interactive Application Development 

One of the commonly used frameworks used by developers to create a dynamic, interactive, and responsive application is Bootstrap. The key advantage of this framework is that it does not require additional tools as it is a complete suite of tools for developing the frontend development. 

  • Custom Application Development and Content Management Systems

Custom App Development is essential for companies who require their  product to be unique to avoid its similarity with the competitors. CMS in JS can be designed to be simple, interactive, and customized without applying other frameworks and coding languages.

  • eCommerce Custom Application Development

CAD in eCommerce is demanding due to the rise of services conducted via the Internet. These platforms can cover numerous operations, from selling and delivering to supporting and marketing. 

  • Customization, Implementation, and Migration 

JavaScript is not only designed to develop the software from scratch, developers can also implement new features and modules to the existing product and make it customized per customers’ request. It also enables developers to migrate numerous on-premise workloads easy and fast.
